item.title: Evolution of Diffusion Model
item.description: Introduction In the past few years, artificial intelligence (AI) has made huge progress in creating realistic images, videos, music, and even human-like voices. A big reason behind this progress is the invention of generative models. These models are designed to create new things - like pictures of people who don’t exist or completely new songs that sound like they were made by a professional artist. At the core of generative models is the concept of probability distributions.
